description:
We are Moon-jigi, two close friends studying together at KAIST.

Our name is a Korean wordplay. "Moonjigi (문지기)" means gatekeeper in Korean, and "moon (문)" means gate. So we are the keepers of the Moon's gate. Our project does just that: it scores landing sites at the lunar south pole and decides which ones are ready to let a mission through.

We love technology, science, and solving real-world problems from an engineering perspective, and we're excited to bring that curiosity to the NASA Space Apps Challenge!
